description: This file defines a React component called AvailableTeamsPanel that displays a list of available teams, allows users to join a team, and handles fetching data from the networking layer. It manages state related to available teams and integrates UI elements from the Tremor React component library.

methods.name: AvailableTeamsPanel
methods.description: React functional component that renders the list of available teams, handles fetching data, and user interactions such as joining a team.

methods.name: handleJoinTeam
methods.description: Handles the event to join a team, calls the networking function, shows notifications, and updates state.
